_meta.description: Per city, how many customers live in the north region (AGG_FREQUENCY with params.value, a scalar count of rows equal to one value; its components add match_count and share of the city's non-null rows) beside every customer counted (AGG_COUNT). The same count as FILTER_INCLUDE on north + AGG_COUNT, without dropping the other rows. The count of the most common region is AGG_MODE_COUNT instead.
_meta.name: value_frequency
